title: ZOE benchmark result
description: One zodbshootout run of one storage, on one machine, with one Python build. Results are numbers about a synthetic corpus, never data.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A change that a reader of the previous version cannot read increments it.

storage.description: The storage under test: filestorage, zeo, relstorage (PostgreSQL), relstorage-hf (PostgreSQL, keep-history false), zoe (ZOE in-process), zoe-server (zoe serve, through a ZEO client) or zoe-native (zoe serve, through the native client of zoe.zeo.ClientStorage).

machine.description: The machine that ran the benchmark. It holds no host name, user name or path.

name.description: A stable name for the machine, used as a path segment in the results repository.

disk.description: The physical device that holds the storage files, or null when the harness cannot see it (for example in a container).

python.description: The Python build that ran zodbshootout and the storage clients.

free_threaded.description: True for a build without the GIL, such as 3.14t.

software.description: The version of each distribution and server in the run, keyed by name.

quick.description: True for the quick set of the pull-request gate, false for the full nightly set.

started.description: When the run started, in UTC.

commit.description: The ZOE commit of the harness, or null when it is not known.

scenarios.description: One entry per zodbshootout scenario and cell. A cell is a mode, a concurrency and an object size.

name.description: add, update, read_cold, read_warm (zodbshootout's write/read: write the objects, then read them back in the next transaction) or read_hot.

mode.description: threads: one process whose threads share one DB. processes: one process per worker.

object_size.description: The approximate size of one object, in bytes.

samples.description: The number of samples after warm-up. A sample is the time per transaction of one zodbshootout loop.

ops_per_second.description: Objects read or written per second by all workers together: concurrency times objects_per_transaction, divided by mean_seconds.

mean_seconds.description: The mean time for the slowest worker to do one transaction of objects_per_transaction objects.

p50_seconds.description: The median of the same times.

p99_seconds.description: The 99th percentile of the same times.

workers.description: One item per Python process of the zodbshootout runs of this scenario and cell that imported ZODB: the zodbshootout process, its pyperf worker and, in the processes mode, the process of each worker. Optional: results without it stay valid.

gil_enabled.description: sys._is_gil_enabled() when the process ended; true on a build with the GIL.

gil_enabled_by.description: The modules that turned the GIL back on in the process, from the warnings of CPython. Empty on a build with the GIL.
